common.footerIgnore: If you didn't expect this email, you can safely ignore it.

welcome.subject: {appName} - Welcome!
welcome.subtitle: Welcome to {appName}
welcome.body:
Hello {firstName},

Welcome to {appName}! Your account has been successfully created and is ready to use.

passwordReset.subject: {appName} - Password Reset Request
passwordReset.subtitle: Password Reset
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset your password. This link will expire in {expiresInMinutes} minutes.
passwordReset.info: If you did not request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your password will not change.

accountDeactivated.subject: {appName} - Account Deactivated
accountDeactivated.subtitle: Account Deactivated
accountDeactivated.body:
Hello {firstName},

Your account has been deactivated. You will no longer be able to sign in.
accountDeactivated.info: If you believe this was done in error, please contact your administrator.
accountDeactivated.infoContact: If you believe this was done in error, please contact your administrator at {adminContactEmail}.

accountReactivated.subject: {appName} - Account Reactivated
accountReactivated.subtitle: Account Reactivated
accountReactivated.body:
Hello {firstName},

Great news! Your account has been reactivated. You can now sign in and access all your files.

shareInvitation.subject: {appName} - {senderName} shared files with you
shareInvitation.subtitle: Files Shared With You
shareInvitation.info: This share is available to anyone with the link.
shareInvitation.infoPassword: This share is password-protected. You will be prompted to enter a password.
shareInvitation.infoExpires: This share link will expire on {expiresAt}.
shareInvitation.infoPasswordExpires: This share is password-protected and will expire on {expiresAt}.

shareDownloaded.subject: {appName} - A file was downloaded from your share
shareDownloaded.subtitle: File Downloaded
shareDownloaded.bodyAnonymous: Someone downloaded {fileName} from your share {shareName} on {downloadedAt}.

shareExpiring.subject: {appName} - Your share is expiring soon
shareExpiring.subtitle: Share Expiring Soon
shareExpiring.body: Your share {shareName} will expire on {expiresAt}. After expiration, recipients will no longer be able to access the files.

shareExpired.subject: {appName} - Your share has expired
shareExpired.subtitle: Share Expired
shareExpired.body: Your share {shareName} expired on {expiredAt}. Recipients can no longer access the files.

shareMaxViewsReached.subject: {appName} - Your share has reached its view limit
shareMaxViewsReached.subtitle: Share View Limit Reached
shareMaxViewsReached.body: Your share {shareName} has reached its maximum view count of {maxViews}. The share is now inaccessible to new visitors.

shareNoActivity.subject: {appName} - Your share has had no recent activity
shareNoActivity.subtitle: No Recent Activity
shareNoActivity.body: Your share {shareName} has had no activity for {inactivityDays} days. Consider renewing or removing it.

reverseShareInvitation.subject: {appName} - {senderName} is requesting files from you
reverseShareInvitation.subtitle: File Upload Request
reverseShareInvitation.body: {senderName} is requesting files via {reverseShareName}. Click the button below to upload your files.
reverseShareInvitation.info: Anyone with this link can upload files.
reverseShareInvitation.infoPassword: This upload link is password-protected. You will be prompted to enter a password.
reverseShareInvitation.infoExpires: This upload link will expire on {expiresAt}.
reverseShareInvitation.infoPasswordExpires: This upload link is password-protected and will expire on {expiresAt}.

reverseShareUploaded.subject: {appName} - New files uploaded to your request
reverseShareUploaded.subtitle: Files Uploaded

reverseShareExpiring.subject: {appName} - Your file request link is expiring soon
reverseShareExpiring.subtitle: Upload Request Expiring Soon
reverseShareExpiring.body: Your file request {reverseShareName} will expire on {expiresAt}. After expiration, no one will be able to upload files using this link.

reverseShareExpired.subject: {appName} - Your file request link has expired
reverseShareExpired.subtitle: Upload Request Expired
reverseShareExpired.body: Your file request {reverseShareName} expired on {expiredAt}. No more files can be uploaded using this link.

quotaWarning.subject: {appName} - Storage quota warning
quotaWarning.subtitle: Storage Quota Warning
quotaWarning.body: You are using {usedPercent}% of your storage quota ({usedBytes} bytes of {maxBytes} bytes). Consider removing old files to free up space.
quotaWarning.info: You have used {usedPercent}% of your available storage.

quotaExceeded.subject: {appName} - Storage quota exceeded
quotaExceeded.subtitle: Storage Quota Exceeded
quotaExceeded.body: You have exceeded your storage quota. You are currently using {usedBytes} bytes out of {maxBytes} bytes. New uploads will be blocked until you free up space.
quotaExceeded.bodyGrace: You have exceeded your storage quota. You are currently using {usedBytes} bytes out of {maxBytes} bytes. You have {gracePeriodDays} day(s) to free up space before uploads are blocked.
quotaExceeded.info: Please delete old files to restore your upload capability.

filesAutoDeleted.subject: {appName} - Files automatically deleted
filesAutoDeleted.subtitle: Files Automatically Deleted
filesAutoDeleted.body: The following files were automatically deleted: {fileList}. Reason: {reason}.
filesAutoDeleted.info: This action was performed automatically by the system cleanup policy.

shareAutoDeleted.subject: {appName} - Share automatically deleted
shareAutoDeleted.subtitle: Share Automatically Deleted
shareAutoDeleted.body: Your share {shareName} was automatically deleted. Reason: {reason}.
shareAutoDeleted.info: This action was performed automatically by the system cleanup policy.

sharePendingDeletion.subject: {appName} - Your share will be permanently deleted soon
sharePendingDeletion.subtitle: Share Scheduled for Deletion
sharePendingDeletion.body: Your expired share {shareName} will be permanently deleted on {deletionAt}. Download or renew it before then if you still need it.
sharePendingDeletion.info: This is performed automatically by the system cleanup policy. Renewing the share cancels the deletion.

reverseSharePendingDeletion.subject: {appName} - Your file request and its files will be deleted soon
reverseSharePendingDeletion.subtitle: Upload Request Scheduled for Deletion
reverseSharePendingDeletion.body: Your expired file request {reverseShareName} and the files uploaded to it will be permanently deleted on {deletionAt}. Download the files or renew the request before then if you still need them.
reverseSharePendingDeletion.info: This is performed automatically by the system cleanup policy. Renewing the request cancels the deletion.

reverseShareAutoDeleted.subject: {appName} - Your file request was automatically deleted
reverseShareAutoDeleted.subtitle: Upload Request Automatically Deleted
reverseShareAutoDeleted.body: Your expired file request {reverseShareName} and the files uploaded to it were permanently deleted on {deletedAt}.
reverseShareAutoDeleted.info: This action was performed automatically by the system cleanup policy.

adminUserRegistered.subject: {appName} - New user registration
adminUserRegistered.subtitle: New User Registered

adminQuotaAlert.subject: {appName} - User quota alert
adminQuotaAlert.subtitle: User Storage Quota Alert
adminQuotaAlert.info: This user has used {usedPercent}% of their storage quota.

testEmail.subject: {appName} - Test Email
testEmail.subtitle: Test Email
testEmail.body: This is a test email sent from {appName}. If you received this message, your email configuration is working correctly.
testEmail.bodyCustom:
This is a test email sent from {appName}.

{testMessage}
testEmail.info: This email was sent as a test. No action is required.
